$comment: Read by tools/monitor/check.mjs (every 2 h). A feed is down when its last successful fetch is older than maxStaleMinutes.
label: outage
titlePrefix: แหล่งข้อมูลล่ม:

groups.$comment: edge: Cloudflare cron every 10 min. runner: dispatched every 40 min (GitHub fallback schedule every 3 h, can lag 2-3 h), so 6 h. Keep in sync with FEED_MAX_AGE_MINUTES in packages/core/src/feeds.ts.

feeds.$comment: Per-feed overrides. cctv is fetched once a day (INGEST.runnerFeedEveryHours.cctv = 24): 24 h + 6 h runner lag = 1800 min. NASA fires (FIRMS) and events (EONET) are runner feeds fetched every run, so the runner default (360 min) already tolerates a short NASA outage without opening an issue; no override needed.
